# Ardafis Partners

> Outsourced bookkeeping, payroll, tax-prep, and advisory support for US CPA firms and solo practitioners. ACCA-qualified team, QuickBooks & Xero Certified.

Ardafis Partners is an outsourced accounting provider serving US CPA firms and solo practitioners (subcontracting/back-office model), plus a newly launched practice serving Gulf-region small businesses directly. Pricing is per-client, hourly, or per-return — no dedicated-staff contracts required. Our team prepares work; the client's own licensed CPA or EA reviews, signs, and retains professional responsibility.
